seo.title: Ship Design & Vessel Conversion Services | LASAN MARINE
seo.description: Ship design for newbuilds and conversions: hull form, hydrostatics, stability, resistance, structures, propulsion, shafting and technical drawings.

fields.headline: Ship design from operating requirements to technical documentation
fields.lead: LASAN MARINE handles newbuild and conversion design and specialist calculations. Depending on where your project stands, we can deliver the full package or only the calculations, drawings and documents still missing.

items.problem: I'm preparing to build a new vessel
items.context: You know the vessel type, function, operating area or key constraints, but there is no complete technical design yet.
items.solution: Develop principal dimensions, hull form, general arrangement, structure and propulsion, then produce the calculations, drawings and documents within the agreed scope.

items.problem: I need to convert a vessel in service
items.context: Lengthening · Raised cabin · Change of function · Re-engining · New equipment
items.solution: Review the documents and current condition to find what the change affects, then recheck the calculations and update the drawings needed.

items.context: There is no need to redo the whole package.
items.solution: Carry out hydrostatics, stability, resistance, engine power, propeller, shafting or structural calculations on their own.

items.problem: I have documents but some items are missing
items.context: Some calculations, drawings or documents are not yet enough for plan approval, classification or as-built records.
items.solution: Review the existing package, identify what is missing and add the calculations, drawings or documents required.

items.title: Can we start if I don't have complete documents?
items.content: Yes. Just send the information and documents you have.

items.title: What does the timeline depend on?
items.content: The vessel type, the scope of work, the state of the input data and the level of plan approval.

items.title: Does LASAN MARINE support the classification process?

fields.heading: You don’t need a complete package before you get in touch
fields.description: Send the vessel type, what needs doing and the documents you have. We will review them and tell you what else is needed before work begins.
